---
name: Feature request
about: Something Pinpoint should be able to do
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**
The situation, not the solution — "I want the agent to know which CSS rule set this
colour" rather than "add chrome.debugger support".

**What happens today**
How you work around it now, if you do.

**What you have in mind** (optional)
If you already have a shape in mind, describe it. If you do not, that is fine — the
problem is the useful part.

**Does it belong in the extension, the bridge, or both?** (optional)
